title: i66_route
description: Resolves origin/destination (label or node id) against oracles/i66.json, VDOT's own I-66 Inside-the-Beltway calculator, to the (start_zone_id, end_zone_id) key into trip_pricing_i66 — then prices that key over RDS as of at_time (default: now, America/New_York), returning the most recently published row at or before that time. VDOT already enumerates every valid direction+entry+exit trip directly, so route resolution is a flat lookup, never traversal. Design: docs/oracle-tools-spec.md; version enforced by tests/test_tool_schemas.py.

origin.description: Interchange label (e.g. 'Fairfax Drive'), case-insensitive, or the oracle's raw node id (e.g. '4') as a fallback.

at_time.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. '2026-07-26T14:32:00' or with an explicit UTC offset); a value with no offset is assumed America/New_York. Defaults to now (America/New_York) if omitted. The price returned is the most recently published row at or before this time, never the price this instant -- VDOT's own feed trails real-time by roughly 10-20 minutes (docs/oracle-findings.md section 7); each leg's priced_as_of exposes exactly how stale.

origin.description: Echoes the caller's raw input string.

destination.description: Echoes the caller's raw input string.

at_time.description: The resolved, ISO-8601 time actually used for pricing (the caller's at_time, or now in America/New_York if omitted).

legs.description: Exactly one priced leg for i66.

priced_as_of.description: ISO-8601 interval_end_at of the trip_pricing_i66 row actually used -- typically earlier than at_time, since that row is the most recent one published at or before it.

error.description: Unknown origin/destination identifier, no direct trip between a known pair, an ambiguous match (unreachable today), a malformed at_time, or no priced row found in trip_pricing_i66 at or before at_time.

valid_options.description: Non-empty only for resolution errors, where it lists self-correction candidates (the full interchange label list on an unknown identifier, or the reachable destination labels from a known origin). Empty for a malformed at_time or a pricing miss, since retrying the same inputs won't fix either.

examples.error: unknown origin 'I-66 Wset': no matching label or node id in the i66 oracle
no price found for zone pair (3100, 3110) at or before 2026-07-26T14:32:00-04:00 in trip_pricing_i66
